title: McDonald's Isn't Really a Burger Company 🍔 #shorts
description:
In the 1950s, Ray Kroc's franchising made little money - until his finance chief Harry Sonneborn bought the land under the restaurants and rented it to the franchise owners. Sonneborn is quoted as saying they were not in the hamburger business, but in real estate. Today franchisees pay McDonald's billions in rent every year.
